sources.query: SELECT count(*)::float8 AS landed FROM (SELECT id, (properties->>'amount')::numeric AS amount, (properties->>'isfraud')::boolean AS fraud, properties->>'timestamp' AS timestamp FROM paysim_demo.graphnode WHERE label='transaction') t

SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(amount),0)/1000000,2)::float8 AS volume_m FROM (SELECT id, (properties->>'amount')::numeric AS amount, (properties->>'isfraud')::boolean AS fraud, properties->>'timestamp' AS timestamp FROM paysim_demo.graphnode WHERE label='transaction') t

SELECT round(COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE fraud),0),0)::float8 AS at_risk, round(100*COALESCE(sum(amount) FILTER (WHERE fraud),0)/GREATEST(COALESCE(sum(amount),0),1),2)::float8 AS pct_value, round(COALESCE(max(amount) FILTER (WHERE fraud),0),0)::float8 AS biggest FROM (SELECT id, (properties->>'amount')::numeric AS amount, (properties->>'isfraud')::boolean AS fraud, properties->>'timestamp' AS timestamp FROM paysim_demo.graphnode WHERE label='transaction') t

SELECT left(timestamp,10) AS day, CASE WHEN fraud THEN 'fraud' ELSE 'legitimate' END AS kind, round(sum(amount),2)::float8 AS volume FROM (SELECT id, (properties->>'amount')::numeric AS amount, (properties->>'isfraud')::boolean AS fraud, properties->>'timestamp' AS timestamp FROM paysim_demo.graphnode WHERE label='transaction') t GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY day

WITH bands AS (SELECT floor(log(GREATEST(amount,1)))::int AS decade, fraud FROM (SELECT id, (properties->>'amount')::numeric AS amount, (properties->>'isfraud')::boolean AS fraud, properties->>'timestamp' AS timestamp FROM paysim_demo.graphnode WHERE label='transaction') t) SELECT decade, CASE decade WHEN 0 THEN 'under $10' WHEN 1 THEN '$10–99' WHEN 2 THEN '$100–999' WHEN 3 THEN '$1k–10k' WHEN 4 THEN '$10k–100k' ELSE '$100k+' END AS band, round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE fraud)/count(*),1)::float8 AS percent_fraud FROM bands GROUP BY decade ORDER BY decade

WITH shared AS (SELECT identifier_id FROM paysim_demo.identifiers GROUP BY identifier_id HAVING count(DISTINCT client_id)>1), classified AS (SELECT s.identifier_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paysim_demo.identifiers a JOIN paysim_demo.identifiers b ON b.identifier_id=a.identifier_id AND b.client_id<>a.client_id JOIN paysim_demo.payments p ON p.sender_id=a.client_id AND p.receiver_id=b.client_id WHERE a.identifier_id=s.identifier_id) THEN 'with direct transfers' ELSE 'no direct transfers' END AS verdict FROM shared s) SELECT verdict, count(*)::float8 AS identities FROM classified GROUP BY verdict

SELECT p.sender_name AS suspect, count(*)::float8 AS txns, round(sum(p.amount),2)::float8 AS moved FROM paysim_demo.payments p JOIN paysim_demo.graphnode t ON t.id=p.transaction_id WHERE (t.properties->>'isfraud')::boolean GROUP BY p.sender_name ORDER BY moved DESC LIMIT 8

WITH shared AS (SELECT DISTINCT a.client_id FROM paysim_demo.identifiers a JOIN paysim_demo.identifiers b ON a.identifier_id=b.identifier_id AND a.client_id<>b.client_id) SELECT p.receiver_name AS collector, round(sum(p.amount),2)::float8 AS received FROM paysim_demo.payments p JOIN shared s ON s.client_id=p.sender_id WHERE p.receiver_type='client' GROUP BY p.receiver_name ORDER BY received DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT p.receiver_name AS mule, round(sum(p.amount),2)::float8 AS taken FROM paysim_demo.payments p JOIN paysim_demo.graphnode m ON m.id=p.receiver_id WHERE m.properties->>'client_type'='MULE' GROUP BY p.receiver_name ORDER BY taken DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT CASE WHEN high_risk THEN 'high-risk merchants' ELSE 'normal merchants' END AS destination, 'merchant payments' AS channel, round(sum(amount),2)::float8 AS volume FROM paysim_demo.payments WHERE receiver_type='merchant' GROUP BY high_risk

widgets.text:
**Synthetic labels, not a verdict.** Risk totals use the generator’s planted fraud labels. They are test fixtures, not an automated fraud finding. The gauge measures their share of payment value.

**Shared identity is a lead.** The identity chart counts shared identifier values, not rings or accounts. Direct transfers between holders add behavioral evidence; neither their presence nor absence proves intent. The planted family shares identifiers without exchanging payments.

**Watch the replay.** Metrics refresh every 5–10 seconds while this dashboard is open. An actors-only start has zero transactions and empty payment charts. Run `./gxr replay` to populate them. Canvas selection counts objects selected in the canvas; this dashboard does not automatically load or expand a graph.
